name: COMP_005
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (39%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Reliability flag is set, and Invasive trails by only 4 points [F1][F6].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 39%, Invasive 35%, InSitu 18% | Narrow lead |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu, Invasive (90%) | Three classes inseparable |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.38 / 88th percentile | Flagged; input suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Models agree |
| Similar cases | 0 of 5 Benign | Neighbors disagree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules** (regions 0, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Strongest concept-model association against invasive [F2] · Unreliable
- **Lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 2, 6, 11) · context · Descriptive only; no invasive direction [F3] · Weak
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 2, 3, 11) · ↑ invasive · Associated with invasive; spot check 3/20 · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Small contribution; one region only · Validated
- **Nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 3, 10) · ↑ invasive · Very small contribution · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60).
- **Concepts**: Not shown faithful (CI −0.005 to 0.007 includes 0); case leans on Unreliable normal lobules, necrosis, mitoses.

## Could be wrong if
- Reliability flag reflects stain, blur or atypical appearance; every probability here is then suspect.
- Right-hand regions 2, 3, 7 score high invasive risk (79%, 96%, 74%); Benign's 4-point lead is thin.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 7, 11**: strongest heatmap push toward invasive; look for infiltrating tumor and necrosis.
2. **Regions 0, 8, 9**: confirm whether lobules are truly normal; the concept spot check failed 0/20.
3. **Region 10**: possible duct-confined atypia (weak concept); separate in situ from invasive.
